notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
-removed some unnecessary files to reduce install size.
-added a teaser for our new game.
-right mouse click lets you back out of menus now.

notes.title: The Big 2024 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
This has been in the works for a while now, and we’re excited for you to play it!

[previewyoutube=KNPbCSEKlEI;full][/previewyoutube]

The update features:

New Content:
-10 new Extra Levels.
-A few new character clothing options.

Quality of Life Improvements:
-Level Select Menu improved.
-Level Select and Character Customization are now accessible from pause menu.
-Improved Photo Mode.

Fixes & Tweaks:
-Performance improvements to several levels.
-Code refinements.
-Some tweaks and polishes.
-Fixed mouse interaction issues in menus.
-Removed Updates screen, which was no longer being updated.

Oh yeah and the game is now out on Nintendo Switch, XBox One, XBox Series X/S and Playstation 4.

I wanna give a big THANK YOU to everyone who has bought the game already and supported me in my game dev journey. You’ve made it possible for me to keep working on this game while also developing new games. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Small maintenance update
notes.notes:
-Updated engine to Unity 2021.3.16f1.
-Improved anti-cheat measures.

This shouldn't change anything in the game noticeably, but let me know if any new bugs show up!

notes.title: SOUNDTRACK UPDATE
notes.notes:
For the last couple months Stilt Fella's composer Sebastian Laitila has been composing new music tracks and we've been tweaking and fine tuning them to fit well with Stilt Fella's levels. Here's a preview:

[previewyoutube=PbviqjU5K9o;full][/previewyoutube]

This update also includes a number of other fixes and tweaks:
-Added 3 pairs of headphones!
-Added seperate volume settings for master, sound, and music.
-Audio system tweaked so music starts playing when a level loads and keeps playing between levels.
-Fixed some audio issues.
-Fixed incorrect Depth of Field blur in level intros.
-Level 9, The Catapult, tweaked slightly to prevent glitching.
-a few other minor tweaks.

The soundtrack will also be available on Bandcamp and Spotify soon. We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: THE BIG BIRTHDAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Stilt Fella has had a good first year on Steam and now we're bringing you free new content with THE BIG BIRTHDAY UPDATE!

[previewyoutube=uVU4vkXVpAI;full][/previewyoutube]

This update introduces three new game modes:

Rocket Fella
A more accessible style of gameplay for new players, featuring remixed levels to give old players a new challenge.

Fellavision
For the first time you'll be able to see THROUGH THE EYES OF STILT FELLA.

Fella
A mode where you're just a fella.

The new game modes will unlock as you play through the main campaign.

The update also features:
5 new extra levels.
New clothing items.
A bunch of bug fixes and tweaks.

Hope you enjoy the new update, and let us know in the Steam Forum if you find any bugs!

notes.title: The Big Fall Update is here!
notes.notes:
The Big Fall Update is here, along with a weeklong -20% sale!

[previewyoutube=NtziAPoknE4;full][/previewyoutube]

New content:
-Speedrun Mode, with online leaderboards.
-5 new clothing items.
-5 new levels.

Bug fixes and tweaks:
-Sideways rotation bug fixed.
-Level collisions that launches the fella into the air fixed.

The new content will be unlocked once you have completed the singleplayer campaign.

Hope you all enjoy the update! And let me know in the bug reports section of the forum if you encounter any new bugs! :)
